name: Dragonborn

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.desc: Choose one type of dragon using the "Racial Options" button. I gain a breath weapon and damage resistance as determined by the dragon type chosen.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.desc: Exhale destructive energy as an action with a size, shape, saving throw type, and damage type as found in the table. All in the area must make a saving throw with DC 8 + Con modifier + Prof Bonus. It does 2d6 (+1d6 at level 6, 11, 16) damage, half as much damage on a successful save. I can use it again after a short rest.

attacks.name: Breath weapon
attacks.description: Hits all in area; Dex save, success - half damage; Usable only once per short rest

age: reach adulthood by 15 and live around 80 years

traits.name: Acid Breath Weapon
traits.desc: As an action, I exhale destructive energy in a 5-ft by 30-ft line. All in the area must make a Dex saving throw with DC 8 + Con modifier + Prof Bonus. It does 2d6 acid damage, half as much damage on a successful save. The damage increases to 3d6 at level 6, 4d6 at level 11, and 5d6 at level 16. I can't use this feature again until I finish a short rest.

name: Hill dwarf

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.desc: Whenever I make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, I am considered proficient in the History skill and add double my proficiency bonus to the check, instead of my normal proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.desc: My hit point maximum increases by 1 for every level I have.

age: are considered young until they are 50 and live about 350 years

name: High elf

text: Magic can't put me to sleep

traits.name: Trance
traits.desc: Elves don't need to sleep, but meditate semiconsciously, for 4 hours a day. While meditating, I can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting in this way, I gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep, thus needing only 4 hours for a long rest.

traits.name: Cantrip
traits.desc: I know one cantrip of my choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is my spellcasting ability for it.

age: typically claim adulthood around age 100 and can live to be 750 years old
height: range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall (4'6" + 2d10")

name: Rock gnome

text: Adv. on Int/Wis/Cha saves vs. magic

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.desc: Add twice my proficiency bonus to Intelligence (History) checks with magic, alchemical, and technological items.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.desc: Construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP) using tinker's tools, 1 hour, and 10 gp of material components, that functions for 24 hours. I can have up to 3 active. Clockwork Toy: animal, monster, or person that can move 5 ft per turn in a random direction, making appropriate noises; Fire Starter: 1 action to produce miniature flame to light things; Music Box: plays single song at a moderate volume.

age: start adult life around age 40 and can live 350 to almost 500 years

name: Lightfoot halfling

traits.name: Lucky
traits.desc: When I roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, I can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.desc: I can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than me.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.desc: I can attempt to hide even when I am obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than me.

age: reach adulthood at age 20 and live around 150 years

name: Half-elf

text: Magic can't put me to sleep

traitHeader: Half-Elf (+2 Charisma and +1 to two other ability scores of my choice)

traits.name: Skill Versatility
traits.desc: I gain proficiency in two skills of my choice.

age: reach adulthood around age 20 and often live over 180 years

name: Half-orc

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.desc: When I am reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, I can drop to 1 hit point instead. I can't use this feature again until I finish a long rest.

traits.name: Savage Attacks
traits.desc: When I score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, I can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

features.name: Savage Attacks
mechanicsNotes: My melee weapon attacks roll 1 additional dice on a critical hit.

age: reach adulthood around age 14 and rarely live longer than 75 years
height: range from 5 to well over 6 feet tall (4'10" + 2d10")

name: Human
age: reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than 100 years
height: range from barely 5 to well over 6 feet tall (4'8" + 2d10")

name: Tiefling

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.desc: I know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, I can cast Hellish Rebuke once per long rest as a 2nd-level spell. At 5th level, I can also cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is my spellcasting ability for these spells.

age: reach adulthood in their late teens and live around 100 years
height: range from 5 to over 6 feet tall (4'9" + 2d8")
